_doc: The explanation ladder (owner EV2 A, 2026-11-06) for all ten stems. Rows marked ruled come from the Blade's script (V0-V9 A, 2026-11-13); rows marked draft are new, for the owner to rule. After ruling, these move into the stations (TEMPLATED/tpl_ladder.json and STEM/*.json) through the usual pipeline.

naming_footnote.text: Your Day Master is the element of the day you were born, read as your core self. It is not your year animal.

model_heading.text: Everyone holds all five elements. In you, each one runs a part of your life.

model_close.text: The next five cards take them one at a time.

Wood.text: Wood is the element of growth. It reaches, builds and keeps going.

Fire.text: Fire is the element of warmth. It lights, warms and draws people in.

Earth.text: Earth is the element of ground. It holds, steadies and supports.

Metal.text: Metal is the element of clarity. It sorts, cuts and decides.

Water.text: Water is the element of flow. It moves, senses and finds a way.

Body.text: Body is you yourself: confidence, limits, standing your ground.

Mind.text: Mind is how you take things in: learning, thinking, rest, the people you lean on.

Expression.text: Expression is how you put yourself out: speaking, making, showing what you feel.

Action.text: Action is what you go after: work, money, results you can point to.

Order.text: Order is the rules, deadlines and people you answer to.

heading.text: You run Overfueled: more comes into you than goes out.

body.text: You take in, prepare and carry more than you let out. It makes you steady under pressure. It also means energy builds up with nowhere to go, and it comes out as impatience.

try.text: Let one thing out each day: a decision, a sentence, a finished draft.

heading.text: You run Underfueled: more goes out of you than comes in.

body.text: You give, spend and adapt more than you take in. It makes you flexible and generous. It also means you run low, and you feel it as a tiredness that is hard to explain.

try.text: Take one thing in each day: a slow meal, an hour of rest, a word of help.

heading.text: You run Balanced: what comes in roughly matches what goes out.

body.text: You take in about as much as you give. It makes you steady and hard to tip over. The work is keeping it that way when a hard season pushes you off centre.

try.text: Notice which energy a hard week pulls on, and feed it back that weekend.

Body.text: Body mode: you trust yourself first and lean on your own strength.

Order.text: Order mode: you hold yourself to rules and to the standards others set.

element_line.text: Yang Metal, steel that has already been through the fire.

recognition.text: You'd rather say the true thing than the easy one.

as_line.text: As a Blade, you are that edge in a person.

behaviour.text: You see the flaw in a plan before anyone asks.

contrast.text: People see someone sharp and certain. Inside, you are checking every word for whether it is true.

self_nature.text: Metal is your own element: the edge itself.

overrides.in_you.Order.thin: You have almost none. Without someone real to answer to, you sharpen alone and wait for a test worth meeting.
overrides.notice.Order.low: you do your best work when someone whose judgement you respect sets the bar.
overrides.need_phrase.Order: real stakes from outside, someone or something that tests the edge

recognition.text: You know good from almost good at a glance.

as_line.text: As a Jewel, you are that finish in a person.

behaviour.text: You go back to fix a detail most people would not see.

contrast.text: People see someone polished and composed. Inside, you are still finding what isn't quite right.

self_nature.text: Metal is your own element: the cut stone itself.

recognition.text: You start before the path is clear.

behaviour.text: You are already planning the next thing before this one ends.

behaviour.text: You change the route without changing where you're headed.

contrast.text: People read you as easygoing. Inside, you are working three routes at once.
